description: Gets the viaSocket organization's embed signing secret (VIASOCKET_EMBED_SECRET) into the developer's .env encrypted, so you never see it. Use it in SDK setup. Get orgId with get_org_details_by_token first. Before calling, run `docstar-cli key request` in the project folder and pass its publicKey; then run the `save` command this tool returns, then its `emit` command (the developer can choose another .env file). Never ask for, print or repeat the secret.

orgId.description: The orgId the key is created for

publicKey.description: The publicKey printed by `docstar-cli key request`, exactly as printed

name: get_viasocket_embed_secret
